title: Jayco, Inc.: STRUCTURE:BODY:ENTRY STEP:RUNNING BOARD (676 affected)
summary: STAPLES WERE USED TO FASTEN THE STEP BOX ON THE REAR CORNERS INSTEAD OF SCREWS.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE (4,630 affected)
summary: THE GLASS IN THE SWING-OUT SIDE WINDOW CAN SEPARATE FROM THE WINDOW FRAME.

title: ALFA ROMEO, INCORPORATED: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (229 affected)
summary: THE SUPPLEMENTAL INFLATABLE RESTRAINT CAUTION LABEL WAS NOT PLACED ON THE DRIVER'S SUN VISOR. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:OTHER (350 affected)
summary: THE ROOF HATCHES ON THESE BUSES DO NOT MEET THE EXTERIOR HANDLE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (183 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, THE TIE ROD END NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED. EXTREMELY LOW TORQUE CAN ALLOW MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE BALL STUD AND THE TIE ROD ARM CAUSING DAMAGE.

title: MIRADA: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (1,000 affected)
summary: NON-STAINLESS STEEL BALLS (CHROME PLATED STEEL) IN THE THERMAL TRIGGER OF THE PRESSURE RELIEF DEVICE HAVE CORRODED CAUSING FALSE THERMAL ACTIVATION.

title: DORAN MANUFACTURING CO.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND FUSE RECEPTICLE (125,350 affected)
summary: A SOLDER BRIDGE ON THE PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD PASSED UNDETECTED THROUGH A TEST FIXTURE AND BYPASSES THE FUSE PROTECTING THE CIRCUIT.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (27,189 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART (13,000 affected)
summary: A CONNECTOR IN THE WIRING WHERE THE TILT HOOD MOUNTED LAMPS ATTACH TO THE VEHICLE WIRING HARNESS WAS BUILT WITHOUT SEALING PLUGS. MOISTURE, ROAD SALT OR OTHER CONTAMINANTS CAN ENTER THE CONNECTION RESULTING IN CROSSED CIRCUITS, SHORTS OR CORROSION OF THE WIRING OF THE CONNECTOR.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: VOLVO/EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (5,199 affected)
summary: THE TIRE LABEL CONTAINS SIZE AND PRESSURE INFORMATION CONCERNING THE SPARE TIRE. THE LISTED SIZE (155R15) AND PRESSURE (40 PSI) ARE INCORRECT. THE CORRECT SIZE AND PRESSURE FOR THE SPARE TIRE ARE T125/90R15 AND 60 PSI.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LEVER SETTLING (3,050 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE LEVER MAY NOT TRAVEL FAR ENOUGH OVER CENTER TO ASSURE THAT IT REMAINS IN THE PROPER POSITION ALLOWING THE VEHICLE TO ROLL AWAY WHILE PARKED.

title: SCI: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (15 affected)
summary: UPON EXPOSURE TO IMPURITIES IN THE NATURAL GAS FUEL IN COLD WEATHER,  AN INTERNAL O-RING ON THESE DEVICES CAN BLISTER DURING DECOMPRESSION AFTER "FAST-FILL" REFUELING RESULTING IN SEAL LEAKAGE.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END (196 affected)
summary: DURING ASSEMBLY, THE TIE ROD END NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED. EXTREMELY LOW TORQUE CAN ALLOW MOVEMENT BEWEEN THE BALL STUD AND THE TIE ROD ARM CAUSING DAMAGE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (293,043 affected)
summary: WHILE MAKING A TURN, THE EXTRA KEYS ON A VEHICLE OPERATOR'S KEY RING CAN BECOME TEMPORARILY LODGED IN THE SCREW ACCESS HOLES IN THE BACK COVER OF THE STEERING WHEEL.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN (78,000 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL ARMATURE STAMPING CAN CRACK DUE TO FATIGUE AND SEPARATE FROM THE CENTER HUB ATTACHMENT TO THE STEERING COLUMN.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (260 affected)
summary: FRICTION BETWEEN THE ACCELERAT0R LEVER AND THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MODULATOR LEVER CAN RESULT IN INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE TWO LEVERS WHICH COULD PREVENT THE ENGINE FROM FULLY RETURNING TO IDLE.

title: IC CORPORATION: BRAKES:POWER ASSIST:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (1,179 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM ON THESE BUSES USES TWO HYDRAULIC PRESSURE SWITCHES TO OPERATE THE BRAKE LIGHTS AND THE BRAKE BOOSTER PUMP. THE BRAKE PRESSURE WARNING LIGHT CAN ACTIVATE WHEN ACTUAL SYSTEM FAILURE HAS NOT OCCURRED.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:SHAFT CHAIN:PROPELLOR:DRIVE (12,322 affected)
summary: THE DRIVE CHAINS HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY HEAT-TREATED DURING THE MANUFACTURING PROCESS. EXPOSURE TO CORROSIVE CONDITIONS CAN CAUSE THE CHAIN SIDE PLATES TO CRACK AND ULTIMATELY FAIL.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (142,800 affected)
summary: CORROSION OF THE HOOD LATCH STRIKER PLATE CAUSES DETACHMENT OF THE PLATE FROM THE HOOD ASSEMBLY RESULTING IN AN UNEXPECTED OPENING OF THE HOOD WHILE THE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (2,976 affected)
summary: THE TOOLS MAY COME OUT OF THE TOOL KIT BAG WHILE RIDING, FALL INTO THE DRIVE TRAIN AREA AND POSSIBLY LODGE IN ONE OF THE MOVING PARTS.

title: Land Rover: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY (155 affected)
summary: AT PORT OF ENTRY, A QUALITY OVERCHECK OF THE DIFFERENTIAL PINION SHAFT TORQUE WAS PERFORMED. THIS CHECK REQUIRED THE REMOVAL OF THE DRIVESHAFTS. WHEN THE DRIVESHAFTS WERE REINSTALLED, THE WRONG SIZED NUTS WERE USED.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (3,649 affected)
summary: AN INTERFERENCE CONDITION BETWEEN THE BACK CUSHION AND THE RECLINER HANDLE CAN CAUSE AN INCOMPLETE LATCHING OF THE RECLINER MECHANISM.

title: AUTOMOTIVE CLIMATE CTRL.: HEATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER AND VENTILATION (1,087 affected)
summary: THE AMBULANCE OR EMERGENCY VEHICLE EQUIPPED WITH THIS HVAC SYSTEM IS WIRED WITH A CIRCUIT PROTECTION GREATER THAN 20 AMPS.

title: ACCURIDE CORPORATION: WHEELS (372 affected)
summary: THESE WHEELS ARE COMPOSED OF 2 PIECES - A DISC AND A RIM WHICH ARE NORMALLY WELDED TOGETHER. THESE WHEELS LACK THE SPECIFIED FILLET WELDS.

title: Mitsubishi Motors North America, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM:CATALYTIC CONVERTER SYSTEM (2,971 affected)
summary: THE WELDED JOINTS CONNECTING THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER MUFFLER AND THE EXHAUST PIPE WAS INFERIOR. THE WELD CAN CRACK UNDER NORMAL OPERATION.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (4 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM (164,000 affected)
summary: IN THE EVENT OF A COOLING SYSTEM COMPONENT FAILURE WHILE THE VEHICLE IS DRIVEN, THE COOLANT CAN OVERHEAT CAUSING THE COOLING SYSTEM PRESSURE TO RISE TO A LEVEL WHERE A LEAK IN THE HEAT EXCHANGER CAN OCCUR.

title: Hyundai Motor America: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER (14,651 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER'S SIDE AIR BAG WAS IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED AND COULD CAUSE THE AIR BAG WARNING LIGHT TO ILLUMINATE FROM INCREASED ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE.

title: Utility Trailer Manufacturing Company: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (213 affected)
